shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,300p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && cat package.json && sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && cat .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then echo reanchor-present; fi
npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md
timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
git diff --check
git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
git diff --check
git status --short
git diff --stat'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && git commit -m "Report enum validation constraints" && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
